summary: End-to-end ML platforms provide integrated tooling for data preparation, training, fine-tuning, experiment tracking, model registry, deployment, and monitoring at scale — unlike a simple model API, which only gives you inference against a pre-built model. You need a full platform when you train or fine-tune custom models, require reproducibility and governance across teams, or must serve models at production scale with monitoring; a hosted model API suffices when you only consume an existing foundation model with minimal customization. The market is led by the three hyperscaler platforms (SageMaker, Vertex AI, Azure ML), followed closely by Databricks and specialized MLOps/AutoML players.

platforms.name: AWS SageMaker (SageMaker AI)
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go by compute instance-hour, storage, and endpoint usage; no upfront fee
platforms.best_for: AWS-native teams building and deploying custom models end-to-end at scale

platforms.name: Google Vertex AI
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go by training/prediction compute, plus per-token pricing for generative models
platforms.best_for: Highly automated, state-of-the-art ML pipelines and GenAI on GCP

platforms.name: Azure Machine Learning
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go by compute, storage, and endpoint usage; enterprise agreements available
platforms.best_for: Enterprises in the Microsoft/Azure ecosystem needing governance and integration

platforms.name: Databricks (MLflow + Mosaic AI)
platforms.pricing: Consumption-based DBUs plus underlying cloud compute; committed-use discounts
platforms.best_for: Unified, multi-cloud data + ML/AI on the Lakehouse, including custom LLM training

platforms.name: MLflow
platforms.pricing: Free open source; managed via Databricks pricing
platforms.best_for: Open-source experiment tracking and model lifecycle management across any stack

platforms.name: Weights & Biases
platforms.pricing: Free tier for individuals; per-seat/usage-based paid plans; enterprise contracts
platforms.best_for: Deep-learning and LLM teams needing best-in-class experiment tracking and collaboration

platforms.name: DataRobot
platforms.best_for: Enterprises wanting automated ML and governed deployment with minimal coding

platforms.name: H2O.ai
platforms.cloud: Multi-cloud and on-prem (H2O open source + Driverless AI + H2O AI Cloud)
platforms.pricing: Free open-source core; enterprise subscription for Driverless AI / H2O AI Cloud
platforms.best_for: Automated ML, interpretable models, and open-source flexibility

platforms.name: Modal
platforms.cloud: Serverless (runs on cloud GPUs, cloud-agnostic abstraction)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-second serverless compute (CPU/GPU) with free monthly credits
platforms.best_for: Developers running Python ML/AI workloads and GPU jobs without managing infra

platforms.name: Hugging Face (Hub + Inference Endpoints + AutoTrain)
platforms.pricing: Free tier; pay-as-you-go inference endpoints; team/enterprise subscriptions
platforms.best_for: Fine-tuning and deploying open-source and foundation models
